requirements.name: Partner onboarding and authorization
requirements.summary: Enable the platform to verify and activate new store partners and regulatory compliance.

requirements.name: Customer order creation and validation
requirements.summary: Allow customers to submit and validate item selections with delivery instructions.

requirements.name: Fulfillment task routing and dispatch
requirements.summary: Direct specific orders to the optimal store node for preparation and packing.

requirements.name: Last-mile delivery execution tracking
requirements.summary: Monitor the physical movement of goods from the store to the customer's location.

requirements.name: Customer feedback and rating submission
requirements.summary: Capture post-delivery satisfaction data and textual comments for quality analysis.

requirements.name: Commercial agreement management
requirements.summary: Store and enforce commercial terms and service level agreements between platform and partners.

requirements.name: Demand forecasting and resource planning
requirements.summary: Predict future order volumes to optimize agent positioning and store inventory levels.
